interactive.label: Add all channels to setup
interactive.tooltip: Compute a LUT for EVERY routing channel in the loaded file (one per channel: TAC non-linearity is per channel) and assign them all to your detector setup. This is the normal way to use LUTs. Saving a .npy LUT or a settings.tttr.json is optional.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: What do the two tabs do? Read the LUT workflow and the scientific notes.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: A short guided tour: load a file, pick the plateau, add all channels.

interactive.label: Compute LUT
interactive.tooltip: Compute LUT: MAKE a per-routing-channel LUT from a flat / uniform-illumination measurement (the main tool). settings.tttr.json: OPTIONAL, save or load a portable settings file, or assign LUT files to channels by hand.

interactive.label: settings.tttr.json (optional)
interactive.tooltip: Compute LUT: MAKE a per-routing-channel LUT from a flat / uniform-illumination measurement (the main tool). settings.tttr.json: OPTIONAL, save or load a portable settings file, or assign LUT files to channels by hand.

interactive.label: Files
interactive.tooltip: Load uniform-illumination (or, on the settings tab, preview) TTTR files.

interactive.label: Folder
interactive.tooltip: Load supported photon files recursively from a folder.

interactive.label: Database
interactive.tooltip: Select photon files from the MMFDB object store.

interactive.label: Clear
interactive.tooltip: Unload all input files; assigned LUTs are kept.

interactive.label: linear_start
interactive.tooltip: First bin of the flat linear region (or drag the orange region in the plot).

interactive.label: linear_stop
interactive.tooltip: First bin after the flat linear region.

interactive.label: ntac_required
interactive.tooltip: Target number of corrected NTAC bins (defaults to the input bin count).

interactive.label: noffset
interactive.tooltip: Offset subtracted from corrected NTAC indices (or drag the red line).

interactive.label: preview_photons
interactive.tooltip: How many photons to use for the corrected-preview histogram.

interactive.label: Normalize by region mean
interactive.tooltip: Divide the displayed histogram by the region mean (display only).

interactive.label: Auto-detect region
interactive.tooltip: Auto-detect the flat linear plateau of the shown channel's histogram.

interactive.label: Save LUT file...
interactive.tooltip: Optional: save this channel's LUT to a file (JSON, NumPy, CSV or text). Not needed: use Add all channels to setup for the normal workflow.

interactive.label: Export corrected...
interactive.tooltip: Optional: export the corrected micro-times of all photons of the shown channel.
